text:
This run cannot determine whether either hiring plan meets the £400k salary limit, so it cannot put an option forward.

- Annual salary spend could not be checked against the “< £400k/year” constraint; its threshold frame is unknown, and the model measures it only as a calculated change.
- Salary effects are missing for all four options, so this run treated each as leaving annual salary spend unchanged. The delivery and onboarding inputs are also Olumi estimates, not user-supplied evidence.
- The comparison is fragile and the model has no stated goal direction for platform delivery, so its provisional ordering is not decision-ready.
